recognition_cue: A dimensional triple-ribbon fibre held inside a translucent dermal architecture lens.
visual_meaning: A recognition cue for collagen as a structural protein family; it is illustrative and does not specify source, collagen type, hydrolysis, molecular mass, route or product performance.

motion_contract.entrance: Reveal the three ribbons as one interwoven fibre, then settle the dermal lens and specification corners.
motion_contract.ambient: Use a finite, sub-pixel opposing drift across ribbon groups; never rotate the complete actor.
motion_contract.resolve: All three ribbons align before a route, barrier or evidence component becomes primary.
host_rules: Animate the three ribbon groups as one recognizable actor until a governed transformation explicitly fragments them.
Use the specification layer to signal unknown form, source or hydrolysis rather than recoloring the fibre as a verdict.
For topical scenes, move the intact actor to the surface; do not pass it through the barrier by default.
For oral scenes, the host transformation component owns fragmentation into peptides and amino acids.
Keep all motion finite, deterministic and owned by one paused host timeline.

chapter_open.purpose: Introduce collagen as the recurring structural subject before route or format diverges.

continuity_anchor.purpose: Keep the fibre identity visible while the building, barrier or route becomes primary.

diagram_node.purpose: Provide one stable input node for topical, oral and structural diagrams.

evidence_companion.purpose: Retain ingredient continuity beside trial filters and uncertainty language.

recap_token.purpose: Return the three-ribbon fibre beside the final action hierarchy.

unknown_version.purpose: Flag a missing source, type, hydrolysis, molecular profile or route.

reentry.first_appearance: Reveal the three ribbons as one interwoven fibre once.
reentry.later_appearances: Use a short fibre alignment or match-position return; do not rebuild the whole actor.
reentry.chapter_return: Keep ribbon order, direction and endpoint colors stable across every route.

recognition_tests.small_size_mode: Keep all three ribbons and both endpoints; suppress banding and minor highlights.

disclosure: Illustrative collagen actor. Source, type, hydrolysis, molecular profile, formulation and route require product-specific evidence.
